name: Stim Probe (research)
description: Research for Executor (no self-stim, but stimming others): logs your Helldiver's action starts, abilities, inventory counts and heals; changes nothing in the game. The test runs itself 10 s after you land (Ctrl+F12 again any time): it throws a grenade, hurts your left arm a little, stims you, and stims again at full health. Keys in stim-probe.ini. Stand somewhere safe. Host or solo. Turn off when done.
